statement: When an employee's employment authorization or authorization documentation expires, the employer must reverify on Form I-9 not later than the date the authorization expires to reflect that the individual is still authorized to work in the United States; otherwise the individual may no longer be employed (8 CFR § 274a.2(b)(1)(vii)), and continuing to employ an alien knowing the alien is or has become unauthorized is unlawful (8 U.S.C. § 1324a(a)(2)).
caveat: Automatic Employment Authorization Document extensions can carry authorization past the document's face date (8 CFR 274a.13(d)), and reverification then runs from the extended validity end. Good-faith I-9 compliance is an affirmative defense to a hiring violation (8 U.S.C. 1324a(a)(3)). This repo does not perform verification or determine document sufficiency.
